newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Mercantile Leasing up on budget news.
newsitem.headline: Mercantile Leasing up on budget news.

text.p: Mercantile Leasing Ltd was up on Thursday nine percent, or two rupees, on a small turnover of 500 shares, brokers said.
"The scrip is gaining due to the budget offering incentives to encourage leasing companies," said a local broker.

The Sri Lankan budget unveiled on Wednesday said depreciation allowances on leased assets can only be set off against leasing income, as an incentive to specialised leasing companies. The move is seen favouring specialised companies over other financial institutions which do leasing only to take advantage of tax breaks. --Colombo newsroom (941) 434319
